_doc: Wave-1 Specialization trees (Fable, 2026-11-10; design in docs/SPECS.md; the roster in data/specs.json). Six specs - Vanguard, Ranger, Pyromancer, Cleric (one per Path) and the hybrids Paladin (Fighter OR Healer) and Spellblade (Fighter OR Mage) - three trees each, 8-9 nodes a tree, levels 10/11/12/14/16/18/20, ranks to 10 (short utilities 3-5). SAME SCHEMA as skills-paths.json (owner = the spec id, tree = the tree id in specs.json); rankOf() already answers a spec's skills through ch.spec. NEW HERE: `altCost` on every hybrid active (the other Path's price, used when the hero's resource matches it: a Paladin from Healer pays altCost.mana, from Fighter cost.rage) and `summon` (ruling 35: `kind: pet` = one strong pet replacing the last, `kind: minion` = up to 8, oldest replaced; `secs` 0 = stays; `skills` in the mercenary brain's vocabulary taunt|strike|self|aoe|kite|bolt|heal|shield; perRank on hpMult/dmgMult). `starter` in specs.json = granted at rank 1 at the spec pick, as the Path starters are. NUMBERS: a spec filler is 1.1-1.3x a swing or 1.4x a Path bolt, big hits 2.5-4x on 8-25 s cooldowns, capstones at 20 on 20-90 s; costs sit where a Path runs flat out ~30 s then lean (temper 15-50, energy 20-50, mana 14-60). Everything here runs on the engine today except the inert cases listed in `wishlist` (two of which are Path bugs this file inherits: armour buffs on heroes and damageDown on foes).

van_crowd_swing.name: Crowd Swing
van_crowd_swing.desc: Swing all the way round for {mult} weapon damage to everything within 4.5 m. Your filler whenever two or more stand near you.

van_battle_hunger.name: Battle Hunger
van_battle_hunger.desc: A crowd feeds you. Every hit you land or take gives more temper.

van_iron_gyre.name: Iron Gyre
van_iron_gyre.desc: Spin for three seconds, striking everything within 5.5 m for {mult} weapon damage every second and dragging it half a metre closer. Moving stops the spin.

van_heavy_arms.name: Heavy Arms
van_heavy_arms.desc: Plate on your shoulders and a heavier swing. More melee power.

van_open_wounds.name: Open Wounds
van_open_wounds.desc: Crowd Swing bites deeper: more damage per rank.

van_hew.name: Hew
van_hew.desc: One great two-handed arc for {mult} weapon damage to everything within 4.5 m, leaving each one bleeding for {secs} seconds.

van_hard_grip.name: Hardened Grip
van_hard_grip.desc: You swing faster the longer the fight goes. More attack speed.

van_whirl_on.name: Whirl On
van_whirl_on.desc: Iron Gyre spins harder: more damage per rank.

van_avalanche.name: Avalanche
van_avalanche.desc: Bring the whole weight of the line down: {mult} weapon damage to everything within 6 m and a 1.5 s stun. The Vanguard's capstone.

van_hold_line.name: Hold the Line
van_hold_line.desc: A shout that makes everything within 8 m come for you and hit 10% softer for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

van_thick_plate.name: Thick Plate
van_thick_plate.desc: You wear plate like skin. Your armour counts for more.

van_iron_resolve.name: Iron Resolve
van_iron_resolve.desc: Set your feet: +60% armour and a {dmg} ward for 10 seconds, and 20 temper to spend. Does not use the global cooldown.

van_bulwark_blow.name: Bulwark Blow
van_bulwark_blow.desc: Smash your target for {mult} weapon damage, make it come for you and leave it hitting 15% softer for 6 seconds. Three times the threat of a normal blow.

van_blood_price.name: Blood Price
van_blood_price.desc: Every blow you land puts a little back. Life on hit.

van_stand_fast.name: Stand Fast
van_stand_fast.desc: The whole party takes heart: +25% armour and heals land 15% harder on everyone near you for 10 seconds.

van_bastion.name: Bastion
van_bastion.desc: Become the wall: a {dmg} ward and double armour for 8 seconds, 40 temper at once, and everything within 10 m turns on you. Does not use the global cooldown.

van_shove.name: Breaching Shove
van_shove.desc: Drive your shoulder through everything in a short arc in front of you for {mult} weapon damage, stopping any cast and knocking them senseless for a moment.

van_keen_eye.name: Find the Gap
van_keen_eye.desc: You see where the armour is thin. More critical hit chance.

van_hammer_blow.name: Hammer Blow
van_hammer_blow.desc: One heavy overhand for {mult} weapon damage that leaves the armour cracked (-12%) for 8 seconds. Your single-target filler.

van_sunder.name: Sunder
van_sunder.desc: Hammer Blow lands with the whole body behind it: more damage per rank.

van_run_down.name: Run Them Down
van_run_down.desc: Rush 12 m at your target and pin its feet to the ground for {secs} seconds. The answer to a leader running for help. Does not use the global cooldown.

van_finishing_blow.name: Finishing Blow
van_finishing_blow.desc: Put everything into one strike for {mult} weapon damage. Save it for what is nearly dead.

van_doubled_grasp.name: Doubled Grasp
van_doubled_grasp.desc: The front of the line needs no shield: hold a two-handed weapon in each hand. The off-hand weapon swings on its own clock for half its damage (bows and crossbows still need both hands). A one-handed weapon can go in the off hand too.

van_shockwave.name: Shockwave
van_shockwave.desc: Stamp, and the ground splits in a 12 m line ahead: {mult} weapon damage, a short stun and half speed for 4 seconds on everything in it.

van_groundbreaker.name: Groundbreaker
van_groundbreaker.desc: Split the earth 18 m straight ahead for {mult} weapon damage and a 1.5 s stun on everything in the line. The Breaking Line capstone.

rgr_broadhead.name: Broadhead
rgr_broadhead.desc: A wide-bladed arrow for {mult} weapon damage. Instant, 25 m. The shot you fire between everything else.

rgr_steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
rgr_steady_hand.desc: A still hand and a still breath. More ranged power.

rgr_full_draw.name: Full Draw
rgr_full_draw.desc: Draw to the ear and hold a moment: {mult} weapon damage from up to 30 m. Your biggest single arrow.

rgr_quiver_ease.name: Easy Quiver
rgr_quiver_ease.desc: Nock, draw, loose, without a wasted motion. Energy comes back faster.

rgr_piercing.name: Piercing Shot
rgr_piercing.desc: An arrow that goes through: {mult} weapon damage to everything in a 20 m line in front of you.

rgr_true_aim.name: True Aim
rgr_true_aim.desc: Full Draw flies truer: more damage per rank.

rgr_broadhead_fan.name: Broadhead Fan
rgr_broadhead_fan.desc: Three arrows at once across a 90 degree fan, 10 m deep: {mult} weapon damage to each enemy in it. The answer to a swarm pouring at you.

rgr_deadeye.name: Deadeye
rgr_deadeye.desc: You see the eye, the throat, the gap in the plate. More critical hit chance.

rgr_arrow_storm.name: Arrow Storm
rgr_arrow_storm.desc: Loose arrow after arrow into the sky over a spot 25 m away: {mult} weapon damage a second to everything in a 5 m circle for three seconds. Moving stops it. The Far Shot capstone.

rgr_call_hound.name: Call the Hound
rgr_call_hound.desc: Whistle, and your hound comes. It stays with you until it falls, bites what bites you, and harries anything you shoot at. Ranks make it tougher and sharper.

rgr_quarry.name: Quarry
rgr_quarry.desc: Name your quarry from 30 m: it takes {secs} seconds of +15% damage from everyone in the party. Longer than a Notch, and from further away.

rgr_hunters_eye.name: Hunter's Eye
rgr_hunters_eye.desc: You have looked at a lot of animals. More critical hit chance.

rgr_savage.name: Savage Hound
rgr_savage.desc: Call a bigger, meaner hound in place of the first: more health, more bite, and a howl that pulls a pack onto it so you can shoot in peace.

rgr_shared_quarry.name: Shared Quarry
rgr_shared_quarry.desc: Quarry lasts longer: more seconds per rank.

rgr_run_quarry.name: Run Down the Quarry
rgr_run_quarry.desc: The killing shot: {mult} weapon damage from 30 m. Fire it through a Quarry mark and the whole party gets the kill.

rgr_old_tracks.name: Old Tracks
rgr_old_tracks.desc: You walk like something that lives out here. More move speed.

rgr_wild_call.name: Call of the Wild
rgr_wild_call.desc: Three wolves answer you for 20 seconds, and everyone in the party hits 10% harder for 15. The Hunt capstone.

rgr_hunters_snare.name: Hunter's Snare
rgr_hunters_snare.desc: Throw a snare onto a spot up to 20 m away: everything in a 3 m circle is held by the feet for {secs} seconds and nicked for {mult} weapon damage. Lay it where the pack will run.

rgr_light_step.name: Light Step
rgr_light_step.desc: Brush and scree do not slow you. More move speed.

rgr_tracker_leap.name: Tracker's Leap
rgr_tracker_leap.desc: Spring 10 m back and land with your eye in: +20% critical chance for 5 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

rgr_hamstring.name: Hamstring Shot
rgr_hamstring.desc: An arrow through the back of the leg: {mult} weapon damage and half speed for 5 seconds. Brutes never reach you.

rgr_pinning.name: Pinning Shot
rgr_pinning.desc: An arrow through the foot from 25 m: {mult} weapon damage, the cast it was making stops, and it stands pinned for 1.5 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

rgr_caltrops.name: Caltrop Field
rgr_caltrops.desc: Scatter iron spikes on a spot: everything in a 4 m circle bleeds for {secs} seconds and limps at 60% speed.

rgr_tight_snare.name: Tight Snare
rgr_tight_snare.desc: Hunter's Snare holds longer: more seconds per rank.

rgr_netting.name: Netting Shot
rgr_netting.desc: A weighted net over your target and everything within 3.5 m of it: held for {secs} seconds and cut for {mult} weapon damage.

rgr_killing_ground.name: Killing Ground
rgr_killing_ground.desc: Stakes, nets and a volley on one 6 m circle: {mult} weapon damage, held for 2 seconds and -20% armour for 8. The Snarework capstone.

pyr_kindle.name: Kindle
pyr_kindle.desc: A bolt of fire for {dmg} that leaves the target burning for {secs} seconds. Takes a moment to cast. Everything else in this tree is about what you do to a thing that is already burning.

pyr_dry_tinder.name: Dry Tinder
pyr_dry_tinder.desc: Everything you touch catches. More spell power.

pyr_scorch.name: Scorch
pyr_scorch.desc: A snap of flame for {dmg} and a hotter burn for {secs} seconds. Instant: the one you throw while walking out of the pack.

pyr_quick_match.name: Quick Match
pyr_quick_match.desc: The words come faster. More cast speed.

pyr_fan_flames.name: Fan the Flames
pyr_fan_flames.desc: Kindle burns hotter: more damage per rank.

pyr_flashover.name: Flashover
pyr_flashover.desc: Everything within 5 m of your target goes up at once for {dmg} fire damage. Throw it when the whole pack is burning.

pyr_long_burn.name: Long Burn
pyr_long_burn.desc: Scorch burns longer: more seconds per rank.

pyr_hot_eye.name: Hot Eye
pyr_hot_eye.desc: You see where the fire wants to go. More critical hit chance.

pyr_immolate.name: Immolate
pyr_immolate.desc: Make one enemy the fire: {dmg} at once and a burn of the same again over {secs} seconds. The Kindling capstone.

pyr_burning_line.name: Burning Line
pyr_burning_line.desc: A line of fire 14 m straight ahead: {dmg} to everything in it and a burn for {secs} seconds. Instant. Stand so the pack is in a row.

pyr_banked_coals.name: Banked Coals
pyr_banked_coals.desc: A deeper well to draw on. More mana.

pyr_fallstone.name: Fallstone
pyr_fallstone.desc: Call a burning rock down on a spot 25 m away: {dmg} to everything in a 4.5 m circle and a 1 s daze. Lands where the telegraph says, so throw it where they are GOING.

pyr_firestorm.name: Firestorm
pyr_firestorm.desc: Hold a storm of fire over a 5 m circle for three seconds: {dmg} to everything in it every second. Moving lets it go.

pyr_spreading.name: Spreading Fire
pyr_spreading.desc: Burning Line burns hotter: more damage per rank.

pyr_ash_cloud.name: Ash Cloud
pyr_ash_cloud.desc: Choke a 5 m circle with hot ash for {dmg}: everything in it moves at 60% speed and hits 20% softer for {secs} seconds. The control tool.

pyr_wide_fire.name: Wide Fire
pyr_wide_fire.desc: Firestorm covers more ground: a bigger circle per rank.

pyr_conflagration.name: Conflagration
pyr_conflagration.desc: Set a 7 m circle alight for {dmg}, a 1 s daze, and a burn for {secs} seconds on everything in it. The Wildfire capstone.

pyr_familiar.name: Stoke the Familiar
pyr_familiar.desc: Breathe life into a little fire. It follows you, throws flame at what you fight and flares when they bunch up. Stays until it is put out; ranks make it brighter.

pyr_warm_skin.name: Warm Skin
pyr_warm_skin.desc: Fire, frost, storm, poison and shadow all find you harder to touch. More resistance to everything.

pyr_cinder_stride.name: Cinder Stride
pyr_cinder_stride.desc: Step 8 m through your own fire: the ground you cross burns everything on it for {dmg}. Does not use the global cooldown.

pyr_flame_shell.name: Flame Shell
pyr_flame_shell.desc: A skin of fire that soaks {dmg} damage for 10 seconds.

pyr_snuff.name: Snuff
pyr_snuff.desc: Pinch out a cast from 25 m: it stops, the caster cannot start another for {secs} seconds, and it takes {dmg}. Does not use the global cooldown.

pyr_ashen.name: Ashen Familiar
pyr_ashen.desc: Bank the familiar into a slow, heavy thing of ash and coal: far more health, a slower swing, and a roar that makes a pack come for it instead of you. One familiar at a time.

pyr_afterglow.name: Afterglow
pyr_afterglow.desc: The fire banks itself between casts. More mana a second.

pyr_pyre_heart.name: Pyre Heart
pyr_pyre_heart.desc: Burn from the inside: mend yourself for {dmg}, wrap yourself in a ward, find 60 mana, hit 20% harder for 10 seconds, and scorch everything within 6 m. Does not use the global cooldown. The Familiar capstone.

clr_brightmend.name: Brightmend
clr_brightmend.desc: Heal a friend for {dmg}; whatever light is left over stays on them as a small ward for 6 seconds. Faster than Mend and bigger.

clr_deep_well.name: Deep Well
clr_deep_well.desc: More to draw on. More mana.

clr_guardian_light.name: Guardian Light
clr_guardian_light.desc: An instant touch of light for {dmg} that keeps mending the friend for {secs} seconds. The one you press while the Fighter is Headlonging.

clr_kind_hands.name: Kind Hands
clr_kind_hands.desc: Every heal lands a little fuller. More healing power.

clr_barrier.name: Barrier of Faith
clr_barrier.desc: A ward on a friend that soaks {dmg} damage for 10 seconds. Instant. Put it on whoever the skirmishers picked.

clr_overflowing.name: Overflowing
clr_overflowing.desc: Brightmend heals for more: more per rank.

clr_swift_word.name: Swift Word
clr_swift_word.desc: One word: a friend is healed for {dmg} and shakes off a slow, a root, a stun or a poison. Does not use the global cooldown.

clr_unbroken.name: Unbroken
clr_unbroken.desc: Barrier of Faith holds more: a bigger ward per rank.

clr_absolution.name: Absolution
clr_absolution.desc: Everything at once on one friend: a {dmg} heal, a ward, and every heal lands 20% harder on them for 10 seconds. Instant. The Overflow capstone.

clr_sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
clr_sanctuary.desc: Bless a 5 m circle up to 25 m away: friends standing in it when it lands are healed for {dmg}, keep mending for {secs} seconds and get a small ward. Lay it where the fight will be.

clr_steady_faith.name: Steady Faith
clr_steady_faith.desc: Prayer between the casts. More mana a second.

clr_circle.name: Circle of Light
clr_circle.desc: Every friend within 10 m of you is healed for {dmg}. Instant.

clr_raise.name: Raise the Fallen
clr_raise.desc: Lift a fallen friend back to their feet at 40% health inside a {dmg} ward. Three seconds of prayer; not in the middle of a fight.

clr_wider.name: Wider Ground
clr_wider.desc: Sanctuary covers more ground: a bigger circle per rank.

clr_lasting_light.name: Lasting Light
clr_lasting_light.desc: Circle of Light heals for more: more per rank.

clr_hymn.name: Hymn of Rest
clr_hymn.desc: Sing for three seconds: every friend within 8 m is healed for {dmg} each second and shakes off whatever is on them. Moving stops the song.

clr_blessed_ground.name: Blessed Ground
clr_blessed_ground.desc: Harden the ground under your friends: everyone in a 5 m circle gets +20% armour and keeps mending for {secs} seconds.

clr_daybreak.name: Daybreak
clr_daybreak.desc: The sun comes up early: every friend within 12 m is healed for {dmg}, warded, and cleansed. The Sanctuary capstone.

clr_sunlance.name: Sunlance
clr_sunlance.desc: A lance of sunlight for {dmg} fire damage that gives back 6 mana when it lands. Attacking is how a Cleric pays for healing.

clr_falling_light.name: Falling Light
clr_falling_light.desc: Light falls on your target and everything within 4 m of it for {dmg} fire damage, and the glow heals every friend within 6 m of you. The smite that heals.

clr_censure.name: Censure
clr_censure.desc: A word that stops a cast from 20 m: {dmg} fire damage, the caster is silenced for a moment and cannot start another for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

clr_zeal.name: Zeal
clr_zeal.desc: Sunlance hits harder: more damage per rank.

clr_judgement.name: Judgement
clr_judgement.desc: Weigh one enemy and find it wanting: {dmg} fire damage and it hits 15% softer for 6 seconds.

clr_noonfire.name: Noonfire
clr_noonfire.desc: The noon sun on a 6 m circle: {dmg} fire damage to everything in it and a burn for {secs} seconds. The solo Cleric's pack answer.

clr_unbearable.name: Light Unbearable
clr_unbearable.desc: A pillar of noon on one enemy: {dmg} fire damage and a 1.5 s daze, and every friend within 8 m of you is healed by the glow. The Falling Light capstone.

pal_sanctified.name: Sanctified Blade
pal_sanctified.desc: A blessed cut for {mult} weapon damage; its light heals every friend within 6 m of you (you included) for a little. Your filler.

pal_devotion.name: Devotion
pal_devotion.desc: Every heal lands fuller. More healing power.

pal_hammer.name: Hammer of Light
pal_hammer.desc: An overhand blow for {mult} weapon damage plus a flash of fire, leaving the target dazed for a moment.

pal_blessed_edge.name: Blessed Edge
pal_blessed_edge.desc: Sanctified Blade cuts deeper: more damage per rank.

pal_radiant_sweep.name: Radiant Sweep
pal_radiant_sweep.desc: A wide blessed arc: {mult} weapon damage plus fire to everything in front of you, and every friend within 6 m is healed by the light.

pal_judging.name: Judging Hand
pal_judging.desc: Hammer of Light falls harder: more damage per rank.

pal_daybreak_strike.name: Daybreak Strike
pal_daybreak_strike.desc: One blow with the sunrise in it: {mult} weapon damage plus fire, and every friend within 8 m is healed for {dmg} and warded. The Holy Blade capstone.

pal_mercy.name: Mercy's Touch
pal_mercy.desc: Lay a hand on a friend for {dmg}. Instant, because you are usually in the middle of something.

pal_martyr.name: Martyr's Vow
pal_martyr.desc: Swear it, and every friend within 10 m gets a ward that soaks {dmg} for 8 seconds.

pal_descent.name: Daybreak Descent
pal_descent.desc: Leap up to 20 m to a friend in trouble, heal them for {dmg} on landing, and everything within 4 m of them turns on you instead. Does not use the global cooldown.

pal_gentle.name: Gentle Hand
pal_gentle.desc: Mercy's Touch heals for more: more per rank.

pal_burden.name: Lay Down the Burden
pal_burden.desc: A friend shakes off a slow, a root, a stun or a poison and is healed for {dmg}. Does not use the global cooldown.

pal_light_within.name: Light Within
pal_light_within.desc: Every blow you land gives a little back. Life on hit.

pal_vow_renewed.name: Vow Renewed
pal_vow_renewed.desc: Martyr's Vow wards for more: a bigger ward per rank.

pal_oathbound_rise.name: Oathbound Rise
pal_oathbound_rise.desc: Lift a fallen friend within 10 m back up at half health inside a {dmg} ward, and the light heals everyone near you. Two seconds; it works in a fight. The Oath of Mercy capstone.

pal_call_account.name: Call to Account
pal_call_account.desc: Everything within 8 m comes for you and hits 10% softer for {secs} seconds, and you take a small ward for the trouble. Does not use the global cooldown.

pal_blessed_earth.name: Blessed Earth
pal_blessed_earth.desc: Bless a 4.5 m circle up to 15 m away: enemies in it are scorched for {dmg} and slowed for 5 seconds, friends in it keep mending for {secs} seconds.

pal_shield_faith.name: Shield of Faith
pal_shield_faith.desc: Set your feet: +50% armour and a {dmg} ward for 10 seconds, and 15 temper. Does not use the global cooldown.

pal_retort.name: Retort
pal_retort.desc: Answer a caster with the flat of the blade: {mult} weapon damage, the cast stops, and it comes for you. Three times the threat.

pal_aegis.name: Shared Aegis
pal_aegis.desc: Everyone in the party takes +20% armour and heals land 15% harder on them for 10 seconds.

pal_unyielding.name: Unyielding Oath
pal_unyielding.desc: You will not fall: a {dmg} ward, double armour for 8 seconds, a heal on yourself, and everything within 10 m turns on you. Does not use the global cooldown. The Bulwark capstone.

spb_starcut.name: Starcut
spb_starcut.desc: A cut for {mult} weapon damage with a crack of storm along the edge for {dmg}. Steel for the armoured, lightning for the stone-skinned: your filler.

spb_bright_arc.name: Bright Arc
spb_bright_arc.desc: A sweep of charged steel: {mult} weapon damage plus {dmg} storm to everything in front of you.

spb_honed_star.name: Honed Star
spb_honed_star.desc: Starcut cuts deeper: more damage per rank.

spb_riven_star.name: Riven Star
spb_riven_star.desc: Drive the blade in and let the storm out: {mult} weapon damage, {dmg} storm, and the armour cracked (-15%) for 8 seconds.

spb_wider_arc.name: Wider Arc
spb_wider_arc.desc: Bright Arc hits harder: more damage per rank.

spb_collapsing_star.name: Collapsing Star
spb_collapsing_star.desc: Everything within 6 m is dragged two metres in, struck for {mult} weapon damage plus {dmg} storm, and stunned. The Edgework capstone.

spb_aegis.name: Star Aegis
spb_aegis.desc: Wrap yourself in starlight: a ward that soaks {dmg} for 8 seconds, and the flash of it scorches everything within 4 m.

spb_tether.name: Star Tether
spb_tether.desc: Throw a thread of light 15 m, drag the target to you for {dmg}, and it limps at 60% speed for 3 seconds. The archer on the perch is now at your feet.

spb_binding.name: Binding Stars
spb_binding.desc: Stars pin everything within 5 m of you to the ground for {secs} seconds and burn it for {dmg}.

spb_steady_star.name: Steady Star
spb_steady_star.desc: Star Aegis holds more: a bigger ward per rank.

spb_null_word.name: Null Word
spb_null_word.desc: A word that unmakes a cast from 15 m: it stops, and the caster is silenced for {secs} seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

spb_long_hold.name: Long Hold
spb_long_hold.desc: Binding Stars holds longer: more seconds per rank.

spb_star_bastion.name: Star Bastion
spb_star_bastion.desc: The constellation closes round you: a {dmg} ward, +60% armour for 8 seconds, 30 temper, and everything within 8 m turns on you, slowed and scorched. Does not use the global cooldown. The Starward capstone.

spb_comet_rush.name: Comet Rush
spb_comet_rush.desc: Fly 15 m at your target in a streak of light: {mult} weapon damage plus {dmg} storm on arrival. Does not use the global cooldown.

spb_thrown_star.name: Thrown Star
spb_thrown_star.desc: A star thrown 20 m for {dmg} storm damage. The one spell a Spellblade keeps for what it cannot reach.

spb_bright_tail.name: Bright Tail
spb_bright_tail.desc: Comet Rush lands harder: more damage per rank.

spb_flicker_cut.name: Flicker Cut
spb_flicker_cut.desc: Cut for {mult} weapon damage and be three metres back before the answer comes.

spb_comet_fall.name: Comet Fall
spb_comet_fall.desc: Bring the blade down like something from the sky: {mult} weapon damage plus {dmg} storm to your target and everything within 4 m of it, and a 1 s daze.

spb_second_comet.name: Second Comet
spb_second_comet.desc: Comet Fall hits harder: more damage per rank.

spb_heavens_edge.name: Heaven's Edge
spb_heavens_edge.desc: Carve a 12 m line of light straight ahead for {mult} weapon damage plus {dmg} storm and a 1 s daze, and end up at the far end of it. The Comet capstone.

wishlist.on: van_iron_resolve, van_stand_fast, van_bastion, pal_shield_faith, pal_aegis, pal_unyielding, spb_star_bastion, clr_blessed_ground (and the Path's fighter_dig_in)
wishlist.rule: A `buff` with stat `armour` on a hero is read nowhere when a MONSTER hits (abilities.js strike/shots use the raw player; only skills.js armourAfter reads it, and only for foes). Rule: `resolveHit(f, armourAfter(p), ...)` in abilities.js strike() and in the foe-shot landing, so +N% armour buffs on heroes work. Until then every armour buff above is inert and the wards/taunts in the same skills carry them.

wishlist.on: van_hold_line, van_bulwark_blow, pyr_ash_cloud, clr_judgement, pal_call_account (and the Path's fighter_war_cry)
wishlist.rule: A `debuff` damageDown/weaken writes an fx of kind `buff` stat `damage` pct negative on the foe, but a foe's damage reads status.dmgFactor (kinds dmgUp / dmgDown). Rule: write `{ kind: "dmgDown", pct }` for damageDown/weaken (or make dmgFactor also read buff:damage). Until then these debuffs are inert and the taunt/damage parts of the same skills carry them.
perRank on the summon effect (hpMult / dmgMult increments) works today through atRank. Nice-to-have: synergyOf(...).damage applied to dmgMult so a synergy node can also feed a pet.

wishlist.on: pal_sanctified, pal_radiant_sweep, pal_daybreak_strike, clr_falling_light, clr_unbearable, pyr_pyre_heart, pal_unyielding
wishlist.rule: Written as a helpful `area` circle at self (radius 1.5-8) so the caster and friends within it are healed, which the engine already runs. `who: "self"` on heal (Path wishlist 6) would be the cleaner form for the three that only want the caster.

wishlist.on: van_crowd_swing, van_iron_gyre (the Warrior's "stronger in a crowd")
wishlist.rule: `perTargetHit: { mult: 0.08, max: 0.4 }` on an area: each enemy hit beyond the first adds mult to the inner weapon multiplier for everyone hit, capped. Until then Crowd Swing is flat per target (already 100%+ of a swing each, so it reads as a crowd skill without it).

`perDot: { mult: 0.25, max: 1.0 }` on a damage effect: +mult x the number of dot fx on the target (from any source). Makes Flashover "sets off the burning". Until then it is a flat area hit after the burns.
`shield.thorns: { type: "storm", base: [a, b] }`: while the ward holds, every melee hit on the wearer deals that spell damage to the attacker. Written today as a burst on cast.
`cond: { targetHpBelow: 0.35 }` x1.5 damage (an execute). Written today as a flat x3.0 on a 10 s cooldown, which is fine.
`hpCost: 0.1` (a tenth of max health) for "spends your own health". Not needed; the ward is priced in temper/mana instead.

wishlist.on: later waves (Druid shapes, Weaponmaster stances, Bard songs, Wyrmblood tempers)
wishlist.rule: `stance.bar: [ids]` swaps the six slots while the stance holds. Nothing in wave 1 needs it.
